sentences.text: Dearcmhara is classified as a basal neoichthyosaurian ichthyosaur.
The genus name means marine lizard in Scottish Gaelic.
Brian Shawcross found the type species in Bearreraig Bay on the Trotternish peninsula of Skye in 1959.
A scientific project did not identify the fossils as a new species until 2014.
Researchers announced the discovery on 11 January 2015 in a study published in the Scottish Journal of Geology.
Dearcmhara lived from the Toarcian to the Bajocian stages, between 184.2 and 168.6 million years ago.
